label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y se paró el pueblo desde lejos, y Moisés se acercó a la densura que allí Dios.
spanish: Y se paró el pueblo desde lejos, y Moisés se acercó a la densa oscuridad que allí *estaba* Dios.
grammarChanges: Replaced 'densura' (thickness/density only, missing the darkness sense) with 'densa oscuridad' for הָעֲרָפֶל (H6205), the dark-cloud/thick-darkness noun, per cited audit fail.
Supplied the missing predicate verb for the verbless Hebrew relative clause (אֲשֶׁר שָׁם הָאֱלֹהִים) as *estaba*, in italics, since the draft clause 'que allí Dios' had no verb.
readerNote: Supplied *estaba* (verb 'to be') in italics to complete the verbless Hebrew relative clause; no separate source token corresponds to it.
